content:
I’m here to express my frustration with one specific negative effect in Caraboo’s kit: 
What’s the reason for making the Poison deal damage based on your max HP when it can be stacked multiple times? I know that when you look at it by itself, 1% doesn’t sound like much, but I don’t think that takes into account what kind of character Caraboo is. She already stacks a lot of HP, and there are also game modes and story chapters that can increase your max HP.
Because of that, after stacking Poison multiple times, that 1% is no longer going to feel small or reasonable. It can quickly turn into something that becomes a serious threat to the entire team.
I’d really like you to consider changing this negative effect into something more reasonable and counterable, for example, dealing 1–10% of your max HP as damage instead, or making one of the Blessings gain Burn.
Caraboo already has a mechanic that allows her to remove Burn, so why not use that same mechanic as a debuff instead? That would give players an actual way to counter it, rather than having a permanent effect like Poison that will progressively wear down the entire team.
If you still don’t see the magnitude of the problem, consider this example: imagine a character that hits multiple times, but every time they hit an enemy, that enemy permanently gains 50 Counter. That’s basically the same issue. The number might not look huge at first, but when you can apply it over and over again with no real way to remove it, it quickly becomes a completely different problem.
I really hope you’ll consider making a change to this effect. I think the idea itself could work, but the current implementation feels unnecessarily punishing, especially when you consider how easily Caraboo can stack HP and how many times the effect can be applied.

I will start by saying that i really love the game and have been playing since the release of Doresain. So I always look up to the Patch notes for exciting changes and character buffs.
However ever since the release of Arachne (a very controverial patch) I feel like I can't trust the devs to truly implement the changes that the community wants.

What do I mean by this? The game, we like it or not, has some issues. But the updates focuses on stuff NO ONE ASKED FOR. Let's be real for a second, what purpose does "convenant bonding" serves??
People been asking for awakener buffs for months now and nothing changed. Wanda, Pandia, Leigh still VERY underpowered compared to newer awakeners. 
I will be very sincere, I don't think changing "temporary" to "permanent" or giving "prepare" to some cards will take this much effort. However the DEVs waste resources changing things that AREN'T BROKEN, like the D-tide system. Why put this much effort and back paddle this much on changes the community didn't even ask for??

Also the game STILL reuses assets as card illustrations. A thing no other card game does. Not even SLAY THE SPIRE, the biggest inspiration for the game. This one I know takes resources, but at least is something uncontroversial that is a standard in the genre. 

And why not change the Propagation Caro realm? There have been TWO (that I've seen)  posts here asking for it and we get nothing? Just a very niche, expensive and, frankly, irrelevant cosmetic?

I am very disappointed with this update and truly hope the next one will be better.
